    Toffoli to flip the phase, then uncomputes the ancillas.

    x = problem_qubits

    # Clause is true unless x1=1, x2=1, x3=0

    # Simpler: use pattern with X gates to make all controls on 1 for false case
    qc.x(x[1])  # flip x1 so we check for 0
    qc.x(x[2])  # flip x2 so we check for 0

    Implements a phase oracle for the given 3-SAT instance.
    The oracle applies a phase of -1 to all basis states |x> where f(x)=1,
    and leaves f(x)=0 states unchanged. All ancillas are returned to |0>.

    x0, x1, x2, x3, x4 = problem_qubits
    a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 = ancilla_qubits

    # Clause 1: (x0 OR NOT x1 OR NOT x4)
    # Using De Morgan: NOT (NOT x0 AND x1 AND x4)
    # To compute clause value into ancilla a0:
    qc.x(x1)          # NOT x1
    qc.x(x4)          # NOT x4
    qc.mcx([x0, x1, x4], a0)  # Toffoli on (x0, NOT x1, NOT x4) -> a0 = 1 if clause satisfied
    qc.x(x1)          # restore
    qc.x(x4)          # restore

    # De Morgan: NOT (x0 AND x1 AND NOT x4)
    qc.x(x4)          # NOT x4
    qc.mcx([x0, x1, x4], a1)  # Toffoli on (x0, x1, NOT x4) -> a1 = 1 if clause satisfied
    qc.x(x4)          # restore

    qc.x(x2)          # NOT x2
    qc.mcx([x0, x2, x3], a2)  # Toffoli on (x0, NOT x2, x3)
    qc.x(x2)          # restore

    # De Morgan: NOT (x0 AND x3 AND NOT x4)
    qc.x(x4)          # NOT x4
    qc.mcx([x0, x3, x4], a3)  # Toffoli on (x0, x3, NOT x4)
    qc.x(x4)          # restore

    qc.x(x3)          # NOT x3
    qc.x(x4)          # NOT x4
    qc.mcx([x2, x3, x4], a4)  # Toffoli on (x2, NOT x3, NOT x4)
    qc.x(x3)          # restore
    qc.x(x4)          # restore

    qc.x(x4)          # NOT x4
    qc.mcx([x1, x3, x4], a5)  # Toffoli on (x1, NOT x3, NOT x4)

    Row 1: [1, 0, cell12] → cell12 must be 2
    Row 2: [cell20, 1, 0] → cell20 must be 2

    p2, p3 = problem_qubits[2], problem_qubits[3]  # cell12
    p4, p5 = problem_qubits[4], problem_qubits[5]  # cell20

    qc.x(p0)   # p0 should be 0, so flip to 1 for control

    qc.x(p3)   # p3 should be 0, so flip to 1 for control

    Implements an oracle for the pattern "0011?" with any offset matching on a 6-bit text.

      text[k]   == '0'
      text[k+1] == '0'
      text[k+2] == '1'
      text[k+3] == '1'
      text[k+4] == '?'  (always matches)
    Since the pattern length is 5 and text length is 6, possible offsets are 0 and 1.
    """

    b = list(problem_qubits)   # b[0]..b[5] = s0..s5
    a = list(ancilla_qubits)   # a[0], a[1], a[2]

    # Equivalent to: (NOT b[0]) AND (NOT b[1]) AND b[2] AND b[3]
